_comment: Single source of truth for chart series shapes. Consumed by build.py (directly), by scripts/sync-ingestion-prompt.mjs (generates the shape list inside ingestion-prompt.md and _shared/knowledge-chart-templates.ts for the ingest validator), and documented nowhere else — edit here only. shape tokens: 'string' = must be a string, 'number' = must be a number, 'any' = key must be present; a nested array means every element matches the inner shape. shape null = series not validated (schematic).

before_after_bars.doc: numbers, or `null` for a value the paper does not report

grouped_change_bars.shape_text: {group, values: [{label, value}]} — one item per group, even for single-group studies
grouped_change_bars.doc: one item per group, **even when the study has a single group**; each `label` is an outcome and `value` its signed change in the chart's `units`

concept_curve.doc: `series` may be `[]`; the `note` carries the meaning
